200.q: I have a tongue but cannot taste, and I get tied up every morning. What am I?
I ring but wear no finger, and you pick me up to answer me. What am I?
I'm built into a house; you climb me to go up and climb me to come down, but I never move an inch. What am I?
I have four legs and a back, but I never walk and never lie down. What am I?
I have a cap but no head and gills but I'm no fish, and I pop up after rain. What am I?
I have a head and a claw, and nails are afraid of me. What am I?
I have wings but no feathers, and I carry hundreds of people without flapping once. What am I?
I fly by night but I'm no bird, and I also hit home runs. What am I?
I have a bridge but cross no water, and I can run without legs. What am I?
I have a pupil but I'm no teacher, and lids but I'm no jar. What am I?
I have strings but I'm no puppet, a bow but no arrows, and I rest beneath your chin. What am I?
I have a spout and a handle, and I whistle when I'm ready. What am I?
I have two slots, I turn bread golden brown, and I pop when I'm done. What am I?
I have a slot for a mouth, I swallow letters, and I stand by the door or out by the road. What am I?
I have two blades that cross, and I only work when I'm opened and closed. What am I?
I'm a roof on a stick, and you only remember me when it rains. What am I?
I have a tail and I dance in the wind, but only when someone holds my line. What am I?
I'm full of air, I'm tied to a string, and a pin is my worst enemy. What am I?
I have a soft belly full of feathers or foam, and I cradle your head all night. What am I?
I have rungs instead of stairs, and I lean on walls for a living. What am I?
I have a bristly head and a long handle, and I sweep up what nobody else will. What am I?
I have a bowl at one end and a handle at the other, and soup is hopeless without me. What am I?
I have prongs instead of fingers, and I stab your dinner for you. What am I?
I'm worn in pairs, I hide inside your shoes, and one of me always vanishes in the wash. What am I?
I hold up your trousers with a buckle, and I have many holes but use only one at a time. What am I?
I'm black, round and rubbery, and I go flat at the worst possible moment. What am I?
I have a door and a light that comes on when you open me, and I hum all night. What am I?
I'm a box that heats your food in seconds, and metal is not allowed inside me. What am I?
I'm a small flat disc with holes in the middle, and I keep your shirt from falling open. What am I?
I have shoulders but no arms, and I wear your clothes while you're not. What am I?
I lie by the front door, you wipe your feet on me, and I often say 'Welcome'. What am I?
I'm a bent piece of wire that holds papers together without piercing them. What am I?
I have a bowl but hold no soup, a seat but I'm no chair, and I'm flushed every day. What am I?
I have a head but never think, and I rain on you indoors every morning. What am I?
I hang from the ceiling, I'm covered in tiny mirrors, and I spin while people dance. What am I?
I have a bell and two wheels, and I go nowhere without your legs. What am I?

400.q: I have a crown but I'm no king, and roots but I'm no tree. What am I?
I have a drum but play no music, and a canal but carry no boats. What am I?
I'm contagious but not a disease; just watching someone do me makes you do me too. What am I?
I come uninvited in little bursts, and people try to frighten me away. What am I?
People bless you the moment I arrive, and you can't keep your eyes open while I happen. What am I?
You've left me on everything you've ever touched, and nobody else in the world has one like yours. What am I?
I've been with you since before you were born, and the day I stop is your last. What am I?
I'm the price of last night's fun, paid first thing the next morning. What am I?
Scratching me feels wonderful, but I always come back for more. What am I?
I'm a mistake you only notice after you've pressed send. What am I?
Read me forward or backward and I say exactly the same thing. What am I?
I'm a line you can always see but never reach, and I back away as fast as you approach. What am I?
I'm a shimmering lake in the desert that disappears the moment you arrive. What am I?
I'm what iron slowly turns into when water and air get at it. What am I?
I'm partly made of you, and I settle on everything you own the moment you stop cleaning. What am I?
I'm tiny, I come from wood, and I get right under your skin. What am I?
I'm a voice with the volume turned down, and secrets travel by me. What am I?
I'm made on birthday flames and falling stars, and telling me is said to spoil me. What am I?
I'm a tree on a tropical beach and the inside of your hand. What am I?
I'm found on an elephant, on a tree, and at the back of a car. What am I?
I'm a bird with long legs, and I lift steel beams on building sites. What am I?
I grow on a palm, I'm a number on a calendar, and I'm an evening out with someone you like. What am I?
Two teams can finish in me, and you knot me around your neck. What am I?
I'm strapped to a wrist, and I'm also what a guard does all night. What am I?
I'm a season, a coil of metal, and a place where water bubbles up from the ground. What am I?
I'm twenty-five cents, fifteen minutes, and a fourth of a football game. What am I?
I hold ink for writing, and I hold pigs on a farm. What am I?
I'm a suit in a deck of cards, a tool for golf, and a place to dance all night. What am I?
I'm on a duck's face, in your wallet, and I arrive at the end of a meal. What am I?
I'm a fried potato, a sliver of silicon in your phone, and a token at a casino. What am I?
I'm baked with chocolate, and websites keep asking you to accept me. What am I?
I live under bridges in fairy tales and in comment sections online. What am I?
I'm a key on a keyboard, a page in your browser, and what you run up at a bar. What am I?
I'm on your front door, and I'm also a curl of your hair. What am I?
I'm a vaccine in your arm, a small glass of whiskey, and a basketball attempt. What am I?
Trains run on me, sprinters race around me, and I'm one song on an album. What am I?
I spin to keep you cool, and I scream at concerts. What am I?
I'm meat in a can, and I'm junk in your inbox. What am I?
I'm the smallest unit of life, a prisoner's room, and what Americans call their mobile phone. What am I?

600.q: I travel fastest when I'm least true, and I grow every time I'm passed along. What am I?
I'm a secret only you should know, made of letters and numbers, and you forget me right when you need me most. What am I?
I'm yours alone, yet you give me away every time you agree to something in writing. What am I?
I rise to your cheeks when you'd rather hide, and no order can send me away. What am I?
I die the moment someone explains me. What am I?
I'm always on my way, I make you work harder the closer I get, and missing me costs you. What am I?
I'm held but never touched, and carrying me hurts the one who holds me more than the one I'm aimed at. What am I?
I'm the place you claim you were, and I'm only needed once you're suspected. What am I?
I'm a gap in the rules that lets people through without breaking any of them. What am I?
I follow you across oceans and make noon feel like midnight. What am I?
I'm the feeling you've lived this exact moment before, even when you never have. What am I?
I'm a song whose success is measured by how fast my audience stops listening. What am I?
I'm what the crowd demands after the show has already ended. What am I?
I'm an ending that refuses to end, and I'm the reason you press 'next episode'. What am I?
I'm three little dots that say the most by saying nothing at all. What am I?
I cure nothing, yet I make people feel better simply because they believe I will. What am I?
I'm nothing at all, and nature is said to hate me. What am I?
I can be a string of words, or a stretch of years behind bars. What am I?
I'm a field for football, a throw in baseball, and how high or low a note sounds. What am I?
I'm a mark that means yes, a way to pay someone, and a threat to a king in chess. What am I?
I hold your dishes in the kitchen, and I advise a president. What am I?
I'm a country's main city, an uppercase letter, and the money you need to start a business. What am I?
A bull does me, a battery holds me, and the police press me. What am I?
Bowlers want me, batters fear me, and workers walk out on me. What am I?
I hold fish, I roll into battle, and I'm a shirt with no sleeves. What am I?
I lift your car, I'm in a deck of cards, and headphones plug into me. What am I?
I'm the last words written about you, carved rather than spoken. What am I?
I'm a road that promises to take you somewhere, then gives up. What am I?
I'm called the lowest form of humor, and I make people groan on purpose. What am I?
I'm what you say when you're okay, and what you pay when you park where you shouldn't. What am I?
I hit tennis balls, and I'm also a shady scheme for making money. What am I?
I sound exactly like another word but mean something completely different. What am I?
